instruction: Design a system that combines two given modules, a 100-bit carry-select adder and a 256-to-1 multiplexer with a barrel shifter. The system should take in two 100-bit binary numbers and a carry-in to perform addition using the carry-select adder. The adder should generate both a 100-bit sum and a carry-out. The system should also include a 256-to-1 multiplexer that selects the input bits using a barrel shifter instead of a selector. The 256 4-bit inputs are all packed into a single 1024-bit input vector. The output of the multiplexer should be generated based on the shifted input bits. Finally, the system should include an additional functional module that takes in both the 100-bit sum and the 4-bit output of the multiplexer to produce a final output of 104 bits.
label: trojan
